scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning, Mr. Hughes. Thanks for joining us by video. I hear you have something to propose.
scene.zh: Hughes 先生早安，謝謝您跟我們視訊。聽說您有事想提議？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good afternoon from the UK! Yes, my customers keep asking about Lantern.
scene.zh: 英國這邊是下午，午安！是的，我的客人一直在問 Lantern。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: My intention is to bring it to the UK this summer.
scene.zh: 我打算今年夏天把它引進英國。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So you'd like to sell the Lantern series in your stores?
scene.zh: 所以您是想在您的門市賣 Lantern 系列？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. Specifically, all twelve stores, starting July first.
scene.zh: 對。具體來說是十二家全部，七月一日開始。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We'd be happy to move forward on that basis.
scene.zh: 照這個條件，我們很樂意往下談。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then we'll need a distribution contract. I'll call our lawyer.
scene.zh: 那我們需要一份經銷合約。我來打給我們的律師。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. UK law is a bit different, so the legal side matters.
scene.zh: 好。英國的法律有點不一樣，所以法律這塊很重要。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: My father was the owner before me. He read every contract twice!
scene.zh: 我父親是上一任老闆，每份合約他都看兩遍！

fills.en: Mr. Hughes would get the ___ right to sell in the UK.
fills.zh: Hughes 先生會拿到英國的獨家銷售權。
fills.note: 只有他能賣，所以是 exclusive（獨家的）。

fills.en: I'll have Mr. Shaw ___ the contract this week.
fills.zh: 我會請 Shaw 先生這週把合約寫好。
fills.note: have + 人 + 原形動詞：請某人做某事。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Before Mr. Shaw writes anything, let's agree on a framework.
scene.zh: 在 Shaw 先生動筆之前，我們先把大方向定下來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: First, the length. How long should it run?
scene.zh: 首先是期限。合約要簽多久？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I think the first contract should run for two years.
scene.zh: 我覺得第一份合約先簽兩年就好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Agreed. A renewal after that is entirely up to both sides.
scene.zh: 同意。之後要不要續約，完全看雙方的意思。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And in principle, what does he get from us?
scene.zh: 那原則上，他從我們這裡拿到什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Mr. Hughes would get the exclusive right to sell in the UK.
scene.zh: Hughes 先生會拿到英國的獨家銷售權。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. In return, he orders at least two thousand lamps a year.
scene.zh: 很好。相對的，他每年至少要訂兩千盞。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The price stays the same for year one. It excludes shipping.
scene.zh: 第一年價格不變，不含運費。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And he'll need a license to use the Lantern name.
scene.zh: 還有，他要拿到授權才能用 Lantern 這個名字。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mr. Shaw can specify the details. We don't want to impose too much.
scene.zh: 細節讓 Shaw 先生寫清楚。我們不想加太多限制。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Come in. I've marked a few clauses in the draft.
scene.zh: 請進。草案裡有幾條我做了記號。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: This one is about liability, if a lamp ever hurts someone.
scene.zh: 這條是關於賠償責任，萬一有燈傷到人的話。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does this clause have to be approved by Mr. Ellis?
scene.zh: 這一條需要 Ellis 先生核准嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. Any change to liability must be approved by him.
scene.zh: 要。賠償責任的任何修改都一定要經過他核准。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then there's your obligation to comply with UK safety regulations.
scene.zh: 再來是你們有義務遵守英國的安全法規。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Under their Product Safety Act, testing is mandatory.
scene.zh: 依照他們的產品安全法，測試是強制的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Just to make sure I understand, every lamp must be tested first?
scene.zh: 我確認一下我有沒有聽懂：每一盞燈都一定要先經過測試？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right. No lamp is permitted in their stores without it.
scene.zh: 對。沒測過的燈不准進他們的店。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll consult a friend in London about which rules are applicable.
scene.zh: 我會請教倫敦的一位朋友，看哪些規定適用。

tasks.title: 讀合約草案和律師的意見

texts.title: Distribution Agreement (Draft): Marked Sections
lines: 2. Term: This agreement shall begin on July 1 and shall continue for two years. Upon expiration, it may be renewed for one more year if both sides agree in writing.

3. Area: Hughes Home and Garden shall have the exclusive right to sell Lantern products in the UK. Harbor Trading shall not sell Lantern products to other stores in the UK, nor shall Hughes Home and Garden sell them outside the UK.

5. Trademarks: The Lantern name and trademark are the property of Harbor Trading. Hughes Home and Garden receives a license to use them in its twelve stores, but not on other products without written consent.
7. Ending the agreement: Either side may terminate this agreement upon 90 days' written notice, or at once after a serious violation, such as unauthorized use of the trademark.

texts.title: My notes on the draft
lines: Most of the provisions look fine, but I have two notes.
Section 3 doesn't say anything about online sales. Harbor Trading should keep the right to sell online.
In Section 7, 90 days is too short for a client who will place large orders, so I'd suggest 180 days.
I also expect Mr. Hughes to ask for a longer contract.

questions.en: How long is the first term of the agreement?
What can't Hughes Home and Garden do?
questions.zh: Hughes Home and Garden 不能做什麼？
options: Use the Lantern name in its stores
Sell Lantern in all twelve stores

questions.zh: Shaw 先生說第 3 條少了什麼？

questions.en: What does Mr. Shaw want to change to 180 days?

options: The notice to end the agreement
The time to pay for an order

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here's the full draft. It's long, but the ideas are simple.
scene.zh: 這是完整的草案。很長，不過內容其實很簡單。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Section five says the Lantern trademark is your property.
scene.zh: 第五條寫明 Lantern 的商標是你們的財產。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: He can't put it on other products without your consent.
scene.zh: 沒有你們同意，他不能把它用在別的產品上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And section seven explains how either side can terminate it.
scene.zh: 第七條說明雙方要怎麼終止合約。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does this clause have to be approved by Mr. Ellis?
scene.zh: 這一條需要 Ellis 先生核准嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, he'll want to see that one. I've emailed you my notes, too.
scene.zh: 要，那條他一定會想看。我也把我的意見寄給你了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll read through the draft tonight and send you my notes.
scene.zh: 我今晚會把草案從頭看一遍，再把我的意見寄給您。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Then we can send it to Mr. Hughes by Friday.
scene.zh: 很好。這樣星期五前就能寄給 Hughes 先生了。

lines.en: Two years isn't in our favor. We'll spend a lot on displays and ads in twelve stores.
lines.zh: 兩年對我們不划算。我們要在十二家門市花很多錢做展示架和廣告。

lines.en: That's why I'm asking for five years.
lines.zh: 所以我才要五年。

lines.en: I'm afraid five years is too long for us.
lines.zh: 不好意思，五年對我們來說太長了。

lines.en: Then I'd also like the penalty taken out. Some circumstances are out of my control.
lines.zh: 那我也希望把罰則拿掉。有些情況不是我能控制的。

lines.en: A penalty is normal in a contract like this. But we could write in an exception.
lines.zh: 這種合約有罰則很正常，不過我們可以寫進例外情況。

lines.en: That would help. And what if a dispute arises?
lines.zh: 那會有幫助。還有，萬一發生爭議怎麼辦？

lines.en: We should say which country's courts would deal with it.
lines.zh: 我們應該寫清楚由哪個國家的法院處理。

lines.en: A court in the UK, I'd hope. I won't fly over for that.
lines.zh: 我希望是英國的法院。我可不想為這種事飛過去。

lines.en: What about a trial for one year first? If it goes well, we can talk again.
lines.zh: 先試行一年怎麼樣？如果順利，我們再來談。

lines.en: Well, I'd have to think about that.
lines.zh: 嗯，這我得想一想。

lines.en: Could we take a short break and come back to this?
lines.zh: 我們可以先休息一下，等一下再回來談這個嗎？

questions.en: Why does Mr. Hughes want five years?
questions.zh: Hughes 先生為什麼想要五年？
options: He'll spend a lot on displays and ads.
His lawyer told him to ask for it.

questions.en: What part of the contract does Mr. Hughes want taken out?
questions.zh: Hughes 先生想拿掉合約的哪個部分？

questions.en: What is suggested as a first step?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I've read your draft. Two years just isn't in our favor.
scene.zh: 你們的草案我看過了。兩年對我們實在不划算。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll need five years to pay for new displays in my stores.
scene.zh: 我要五年，才能把門市新展示架的錢賺回來。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm afraid five years is too long for us.
scene.zh: 不好意思，五年對我們來說太長了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then at least drop the penalty for small orders.
scene.zh: 那至少把訂量不足的罰則拿掉。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We can't drop it, but we could make an exception.
scene.zh: 罰則不能拿掉，不過我們可以寫進例外。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: For circumstances I can't control, I hope.
scene.zh: 希望是針對我控制不了的情況。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But we'd have to agree on which ones count, or disputes will arise.
scene.zh: 可是我們得先講好哪些算，不然就會起爭議。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then a UK court can decide. I'm not flying over to see a judge!
scene.zh: 那就交給英國的法院決定。我可不會飛過去見法官！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could we take a short break and come back to this?
scene.zh: 我們可以先休息一下，等一下再回來談這個嗎？

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Despite our differences, I'm sure we can find a compromise.

scene.speaker: npc

lines.en: Hello, this is Mr. Shaw, calling about the Hughes contract.
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Shaw，打來談 Hughes 的合約。

lines.en: I've incorporated the amendments from yesterday's negotiation.
lines.zh: 昨天談判的修改，我都已經加進去了。

lines.en: That's precisely three years, three thousand lamps a year, and no penalty in the first year.
lines.zh: 也就是：剛好三年、每年三千盞，第一年沒有罰則。

lines.en: The new version is attached to my email, with a short note on each change, for your consideration.
lines.zh: 新版本附在我的 email 裡，每一處修改都附了簡短說明，請你參考。

lines.en: Before we sign, we must obtain documentation that shows the lamps are in compliance with UK safety rules.
lines.zh: 簽約之前，我們一定要取得文件，證明這些燈符合英國的安全規定。

lines.en: The authorities there may ask to see it.
lines.zh: 那邊的主管機關可能會要求看。

lines.en: Two more things. I'd suggest applying for a patent on the Lantern design.
lines.zh: 還有兩件事。我建議為 Lantern 的設計申請專利。

lines.en: And let's make sure the copyright in the product photos stays with Harbor Trading.
lines.zh: 也要確定產品照片的著作權留在 Harbor Trading。

lines.en: Please keep all your correspondence with Mr. Hughes, too.
lines.zh: 也請把你和 Hughes 先生的往來信件都留著。

lines.en: Could you call me back before Thursday? Thanks.
lines.zh: 可以在星期四之前回我電話嗎？謝謝。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: He says the amendments are already in the new draft.
scene.zh: 他說修改的地方已經放進新的草案了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Three years, three thousand lamps, and no penalty the first year.
scene.zh: 三年、三千盞，第一年沒有罰則。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: He also needs documentation that our lamps meet UK safety rules.
scene.zh: 他還需要文件，證明我們的燈符合英國的安全規定。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll look at the changes and call him back.
scene.zh: 我先看一下改了哪些地方，再回他電話。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks. Ask him about the patent, too. It's a good idea.
scene.zh: 謝謝。順便問他專利的事，那是個好主意。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nobody should copy the Lantern design in the UK.
scene.zh: 不能讓人在英國抄 Lantern 的設計。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And keep every email from Mr. Hughes. Mr. Shaw was clear about that.
scene.zh: 還有，Hughes 先生寄來的每封 email 都要留著。Shaw 先生特別交代過。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: If all goes well, Mr. Hughes will fly in to sign next week.
scene.zh: 如果一切順利，Hughes 先生下週會飛過來簽約。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So these are your premises. Very nice!
scene.zh: 原來這就是你們公司。真不錯！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome. Now that everything's settled, shall we sign?
scene.zh: 歡迎。既然一切都談定了，我們來簽約吧？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I sign every page or just the last one?
scene.zh: 我是每一頁都要簽，還是只簽最後一頁？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Every page. Mr. Shaw will sign as our witness.
scene.zh: 每一頁都要。Shaw 先生會簽名當見證人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then we can proceed with the first order.
scene.zh: 簽完就可以開始處理第一筆訂單了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'd like to acknowledge Mr. Shaw. Without him, this would have been impossible.
scene.zh: 我要特別感謝 Shaw 先生。沒有他，這件事不可能辦成。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm so glad we were able to make this work.
scene.zh: 真的很高興我們最後談成了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So am I. Here's to a long partnership!
scene.zh: 我也是。祝我們長長久久地合作下去！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Next, we hope to lease an office in London.
scene.zh: 接下來，我們希望在倫敦租一間辦公室。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hello, both of you! Sorry I'm late. I had a scheduling conflict.
scene.zh: 兩位好！抱歉我遲到了，剛剛時間撞到了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now, my customers love your new lamps. I want them in the UK.
scene.zh: 是這樣的，我的客人很喜歡你們的新燈，我想把它們引進英國。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So you'd like to sell the Lantern series in your stores?
scene.zh: 所以您是想在您的門市賣 Lantern 系列？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Exactly. And I'd want to be the only seller there. How would the contract put that?
scene.zh: 沒錯。而且我希望在那邊只有我能賣。合約上會怎麼寫？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Mr. Hughes would get the exclusive right to sell in the UK.
scene.zh: Hughes 先生會拿到英國的獨家銷售權。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's fine, but the lamps have to meet UK safety rules.
scene.zh: 這沒問題，不過燈必須符合英國的安全規定。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Just to make sure I understand, every lamp must be tested first?
scene.zh: 我確認一下我有沒有聽懂：每一盞燈都一定要先經過測試？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Every model, yes. Mr. Shaw will put that in the contract.
scene.zh: 對，每一款都要。Shaw 先生會把這條寫進合約。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Now, I'd like a contract for five years.
scene.zh: 好。那我想簽五年的合約。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm afraid five years is too long for us.
scene.zh: 不好意思，五年對我們來說太長了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then the price has to come down. It's too high for me.
scene.zh: 那價格就得降一點，對我來說太高了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What if we lowered the price in exchange for a bigger order?
scene.zh: 如果我們價格降一點，換您多訂一些，您覺得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Three thousand a year, over three years? I can do that.
scene.zh: 每年三千盞，簽三年？這我可以。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm so glad we were able to make this work.
scene.zh: 真的很高興我們最後談成了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Me too. I'll tell my lawyer. Talk soon!
scene.zh: 我也是。我會跟我的律師說。再聊！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Well done. By the way, Mr. Shaw has made changes to our draft.
scene.zh: 做得好。對了，Shaw 先生已經改了我們的草案。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll look at the changes and call him back.
scene.zh: 我先看一下改了哪些地方，再回他電話。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. He'll send the new draft this afternoon.
scene.zh: 好。他今天下午會把新的草案寄來。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll read through the draft tonight and send you my notes.
scene.zh: 我今晚會把草案從頭看一遍，再把我的意見寄給您。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Perfect. Keep it somewhere secure. The prices in it are secret.
scene.zh: 太好了。草案要放在安全的地方，裡面的價格是要保密的。
